messages:
Zoe: Quick summary from the 'horizon-lite-9b' int6 bring-up. Ran mixed slices: chat (70%), retrieval (20%), long-summary (10%). Short econ + ops recs below.

Kai: Nice 44d sample sizes?

Zoe: 300 samples/slice. Top-line: infra cost per 1k tokens int8=$0.0118, int6=$0.0069 (~41% infra savings). Latency p95 int8=118ms, int6=205ms. Throughput -14% tokens/sec on int6.

Luis: Quality delta? Any concentrated regressions?

Zoe: Weighted quality drop small but targeted: retrieval MRR -0.85% abs, summary ROUGE-L -0.6, chat human QA -0.03 (5pt). Hallucination proxy +0.6% centered on numeric/date extraction and multi-step arithmetic prompts. CI noisy for MRR (~+/-0.5).

Monica: Ops recommendations?

Zoe: Proposal: 1) Hybrid decision matrix: force-int8 for requests matching retrieval/billing/numeric tags; allow-int6 for chat with est_tokens < 1200 and latency_sensitivity=false. 2) Canary: run 1k-sample shadow for retrieval then live 48h split (chat 5%, retrieval 15%). Rollback gates: MRR drop >0.5% or hallucination_proxy +1.0%. 3) Mitigations: add numeric-check post-filter, tighten retrieval prompts, increase prefix cache TTL for long summaries.

Kai: Can you paste a tiny routing mock?

Zoe: Pseudo-rule:
```
if request.meta.tags contains any of ["retrieval","billing","numeric-exact"] -> model: horizon-lite-9b-int8
elif request.meta.slice == "chat" and request.estimated_tokens < 1200 -> model: horizon-lite-9b-int6
else -> model: horizon-lite-9b-int8
```

Luis: GTN blurb draft?

Monica: "Int6 yields ~35-45% infra savings with modest, focused quality regressions on numeric/retrieval. Recommend a hybrid routing approach: preserve int8 for high-precision endpoints, use int6 for bulk chat. Start with a 1k shadow + 48h guarded canary and require MRR/hallucination gates before wider rollout."

RouterBot: Canary scheduled: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route 5% start=2026-03-25T16:00Z. Monitors: MRR, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Zoe: I'll upload the 1k shadow results + top failure prompts by EOD and tag PMs. :eyes:

Kai: Thanks 44d will prep a short product one-pager for GTN once results land.
